text:
Ashwin: Kicking off a blue->green router shift for service-learner in eu-west1 during the 03:00 UTC change window. Plan: step to 10% -> 30% -> hold -> decide. Tagging @Maria @Tia for on-call.

Deploy-bot: deploy/green/service-learner@v2026-03-21-rc2 finished to green pool. Post-deploy checks queued: health, p95, 5xx-rate.

Maria: Acknowledged. I'll watch p95 and 5xx. Default thresholds: p95 < 300ms, 5xx < 0.5%. Leaving session-affinity unchanged.

Tia: On call. If p95 breaches 300ms or 5xx > 0.5% sustained -> abort + rollback. Also watch JVM GC pauses on green.

Ashwin: Running weighted shift command now: `routerctl shift --service=service-learner --from=blue --to=green --initial=10 --step=20 --interval=2m`

Deploy-bot: shift step 1 executed -> green=10% at 1735006789. Health checks: ok.

Ops-bot: Canary metrics (green): p95 +40ms vs blue, 5xx=0.12%. Within thresholds. Recommendation: continue. :thumbsup:

Maria: KV cache warming observed. Hit rate rising from 12% -> 64% in 90s. Good sign.

Carlos: Observed autoscaler spin-up on green hosts (two new pods). CPU per-node jumped ~18%.

Tia: Noted a small GC spike at 10% but recovered. Continue to 30% but hold there for extra warmup.

Ashwin: Holding at 30% for warmup (requesting 10m extra). Anyone object? :eyes:

Maria: No objections. Change: hold for 12m total to ensure cache and autoscale stabilise. Updating rollout doc.

Deploy-bot: shift step 2 executed -> green=30% at 1735006920. Health: p95 +75ms, 5xx=0.18%.

Ops-bot: Alert (informational): one green host restarted during scaling. Restart reason: kube-probe timeout; pod recovered and passed readiness.

Carlos: Restarted pod did not show OOM, logs indicate transient startup delay for feature-flag initialization.

Maria: Captured logs and created IR-1452 for suspicious feature-flag parser latency. Link: https://internal/bugs/IR-1452

Tia: If p95 > 300ms sustained across 3 consecutive checks or 5xx > 0.5% -> I'll trigger rollback.

Ashwin: Changing rollout automation to manual continuation. Pinning routing to keep majority on blue if we need to swing back: `routerctl pin --service=service-learner --route=blue --until=1735009000`

Maria: Snapshotting logs for the spike: `logs query service=service-learner env=green | tail 200` — uploaded artifacts to the rollout doc.

Carlos: Rollback playbook ready if needed. Command: `deploy-bot rollback --service=service-learner --to=blue --reason='perf spike during warmup'`

Deploy-bot: Action recorded: automatic continuation disabled. Current shift paused at 30% until 1735009000 or manual resume.

Ashwin: Decision summary: hold at 30% for 12m, observe KPIs, rollback if sustained degradation. If stable, resume incremental shift with 10m gaps. Release notes snippet: v2026-03-21-rc2 — tokenizer optimization, KV caching rewrite (watch cache warming).

Tia: I'll post to #incidents only if rollback triggered. Otherwise I'll post a short completion note after we reach 100%.

Maria: Will follow up with a postmortem if we end up rolling back. For now monitoring.

Deploy-bot: final state: shift paused at 30% (green). Timestamp: 1735007345.
